name: load-performance
about: Measures signing in. The client restarts at Stormwind's harbour, and comfyatmos.dll times the first 90 seconds in the world. Before the shader cache, 44 shader compiles took 11.1 s on the game's thread and froze two frames for 5.2 and 7.0 s. Checks: the compiling left on the game's thread (at most 100 ms), the longest frame once the effects start (at most 1.5 s), and the frames over 40 ms after it (at most 12). Recorded: when the effects start, and the shader worker's time.

start.about: Stormwind's harbour, on the dock (as stormwind-harbour-ridge)

expect.about: Compiling on the game's thread at sign-in
expect.log: ^startup: 90 s in the world: .* shaders compiled in all, (\d+) ms

expect.about: The worst frame once the effects start
expect.log: the worst frame from then (\d+) ms
expect.metric: Worst frame as the effects start

expect.about: Frames over 40 ms once the effects start
expect.log: the worst frame from then \d+ ms, (\d+) over 40 ms
expect.metric: Slow frames as the effects start

expect.about: When the effects start after the first world frame
The shader worker's time, from the DLL's start
expect.log: ^shaders: the worker is done: .* in (\d+) ms
